production_server_configuration.command: npm run build && npm run start

limitations: This evidence belongs to run 39445094023 attempt 1 on the final C tree. The prior B 12-case result, intermediate local 152/33 results, and local 15-case discovery are not substituted.
15 cases are five scenarios across three desktop browser projects: one existing app smoke, two external playwright.dev examples, one existing results flow, and the new cache-area flow.

The new cache-area flow uses the real Home UI, localStorage and IndexedDB, synthetic pharmacy API records and a local SVG at the exact QR-image boundary. Its successful assertions do not establish live provider freshness, real QR content, native image export or every network path.
Existing example tests navigate playwright.dev; the existing app smoke does not stub every provider/weather path. No whole-CI offline claim is made.

Source-bound CI uses npm run build && npm run start, package build next build, no server reuse, and no local TypeScript stdio bridge. A successful browser startup establishes the configured stock production-server acceptance; detailed unlogged build phases/static-page counts and PWA behavior are not inferred.

The observed npm ci aggregate remains an aggregate. Full npm audit was denied and not retried; package/advisory paths and production exploitability remain unverified. Targeted Next/Sharp patches do not justify claiming all previous warnings resolved.
The verifier only read downloaded raw evidence and frozen source files. It ran no application tests, local browser, remote request, CI rerun, source mutation, merge or deployment.
